text_block_list.text:
One day, looking for Grass Wonder,
I went to her classroom—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* Here goes nothing~
"For your sake, springtime—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please move, Spe-chan!
El, GEEEEEEET!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...El, that's completely the wrong card~
Taking that one counts as a foul.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh-huh? I felt like the song
went something like this, though~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I'm practicing for
the inter-grade Hyakunin Isshu tournament~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Grass-chan is super strong, you know!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's just, um... El-chan is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying, desu!?
Spe-chan's on the exact same level, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's no waaaay I can memorize
a song that sounds like a magic incantation, desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, it's not a spell~.
Every song has a proper meaning behind it.
For example, the one just now—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"For your sake, I went out into the spring fields
to gather young greens, while upon my robes
the snow kept falling gently."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This poem depicts the scenery on the cusp of winter and spring,
as young herbs were gathered for a beloved's sake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Composing poetry not at the height of a season, but at its turning point,
is such a wonderfully lovely perspective, don't you think~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh~... I had no idea. If it's still snowing
even in spring, shoveling it must be really tough...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Are people really happy to receive grass, desu ne?
Unless it can be turned into a super-spicy spice, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's so like El~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... if you tie it to the song like this,
doesn't it make it just a bit easier to remember?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... now that you mention it, that might be true!
Grass-chan, you're amazing~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Grass! Rematch time!
Right now, El feels like she can totally grab the cards!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, understood~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right! The more the merrier,
so why don't you join in too, Trainer~?
choice_data_list: Well then, don't mind if I do.
I'm going to be the reader, so why don't you join in too, Grass?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then, I will continue to serve as the reader~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you,
Grass-chan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fu, fu, fu. Prepare to bear witness
to El's high-speed, whirlwind card catch, desu!
And so, the three of us resumed our game of Hyakunin Isshu, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. This is such a lovely place, so please listen while picturing the scenery in your mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that poem beginning with 'Hisakata no' just now,
the ancient Japanese aesthetic of 'mono no aware'—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-cha~n!
I'm happy you're teaching me all this, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you stop to spout trivia every single time,
this match will never get anywhere, desu~!

"Though the contest dragged on for quite some time,
Grass Wonder maintained a lively, radiant expression
right up until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! Now I might actually be able to
put up a good fight against Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
S-Spe-chan!
I kinda feel like you reeeally shouldn't—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Thank you very much, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then—I'll just get
a little "serious" with you~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...S-She's smiling, but it's kind of terrifying.

Afterward, the Hyakunin Isshu match between the three
began once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's my win~.
El, you haven't taken a single card yet, though—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gugigigiii...!! One more match!! Give me a rematch, I say!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-So this is how strong she is when she's serious...
Can anyone even beat Grass-chan...?
Having displayed overwhelming ability, Grass Wonder reportedly went on to perform brilliantly in the main tournament as well.
